name: @seneca/store-test
description: Standard test cases for seneca stores

scripts.test: lab -v -P test -L -t 80 -r console -o stdout -r html -o test/coverage.html -r lcov -o test/lcov.info && npm run test-examples
scripts.test-examples: for f in docs/examples/*.js; do node $f || exit 1; done && lab -v docs/examples/tiny-store/test
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm test
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run prettier && npm test && npm run repo-tag && npm publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org

author: Richard Rodger (http://richardrodger.com)
